item.title: Greece Drives Breakthrough in Heart Failure Telemonitoring

item.title: King and Queen of Spain Attend Memorial Service for Princess Irene of Greece
item.description: Queen Letizia of Spain and King Felipe VI attended a prayer service on Friday in memory of Princess Irene of Greece and Denmark, who died at the age of 83. item.title: Trump Threatens Europe Over Greenland, EU Vows Retaliation

item.title: January 18, Feast Day of Agios Athanasios
item.description: On January 18, the Greek Orthodox Church celebrates the Feast Day of Agios Athanasios. item.title: Greece Plans to Expand Territorial Waters, Including Potential Aegean Extension, Despite Turkey's Long-Standing War Threat
item.description: Greek Foreign Minister George Gerapetritis announced plans to extend Greece's territorial waters beyond the current 6 nautical miles in parts of the Aegean Sea, citing successful agreements with Italy and Egypt, while reaffirming Athens' commitment to sovereignty amid Turkey's longstanding threat of military response. item.title: Greece Searches for Missing 16-Year-Old Laura in Growing International Mystery
item.description: Greek authorities are searching for 16-year-old German national Laura L., who disappeared from Patras on January 8 after reportedly spending months using AI tools to plan her escape, selling belongings, and possibly using her mother’s passport—amid serious allegations that her father once shaved her head as punishment. item.title: Pontic Greek Endures: Romeyka Dialect Still Spoken by Thousands in Turkey's Black Sea Region
item.description: Despite the 1923 population exchange that displaced most Pontic Greeks, the archaic Romeyka dialect—a variety of Pontic Greek remarkably close to Ancient Greek—continues to be spoken by several thousand Muslim communities in northeast Turkey's Trabzon area, offering a rare living link to the language's ancient roots.
